The work checks out, but T-074 stays blocked: no newsletter has gone out because Tantra still says team@growthclub.org isn't a connected mailbox. That connection is tracked on T-123. The T-337 key is already saved, so this isn't a new key request. I re-ran the approved test send in this run and got the same error.
